messages:
eva: Hey team — getting multiple reports that POST /v1/rerank is returning 429s for some customers since ~09:12 UTC. Affected traffic is mostly batched requests (size 12-20). Error body: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"quota exceeded"}. Headers show X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 and Retry-After: 2. Seen across eu-west and us-east. Can we triage? 

support-bot: Thanks <@eva> — creating incident thread and pinging oncall. Incident ID INC-2026-142

anya: @michael @henry can you share the gateway logs / rate-limit config? any recent changes to rerank quotas? 

michael: looking now. Logs show spikes of 2k req/min for client_id=acme-prod between 09:10–09:18, many 429s from the throttler at the edge. Throttler message: "per_endpoint_quota_exceeded rerank default_rate=100 rpm client_rate=1200 rpm"

henry: we rolled out per-customer per-endpoint soft quotas last night to curb cost for rerank-heavy workloads. default for rerank was set to 100 rpm (we left docs note in PR but might not have communicated). This is why batched rerank pulses hit 429. 

leila: ACME reported major UX breakage — buttons hang and they see "rate limited" in our SDK. They've already escalated to their CS manager. We need temporary lift while we work on a better plan. 

anya: repro steps request from support: Can someone paste a minimal repro (curl + body) and the exact response blob? Need to confirm it's server-side quota not malformed input.

leila: sample from ACME:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-ACME" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"what are the best ways to...","candidates":["a","b","c",...],"batch_size":16}'
```

Response:

```json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"quota exceeded for endpoint rerank","code":429}
```

Headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 100`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `Retry-After: 2`

michael: confirmed headers match. Also seeing some unexpected scores from rerank prior to 429s but likely unrelated — might be caused by partial timeouts. 

henry: short-term mitigation options:
- bump quota for acme-prod to 600 rpm on their token (manual override)
- enable burst policy for rerank for trusted customers
- add explicit 429 retry guidance in SDK with exponential backoff and jitter

anya: I'll apply temporary token-level quota bump to ACME and other big customers affected. Creating support ticket to track. 

billing-bot: Note: quota bump will affect billing metrics — estimated +12% monthly inference cost for ACME if sustained.

leila: please notify ACME if we bump. I will coordinate messaging. 

anya: done — applied temporary bump to 600 rpm for client_id=acme-prod and added a 5min cooldown window before re-evaluating. I also pushed a short-term rule to allow bursts up to 1200 rpm for 60s. 

michael: monitoring dashboard looks better, 429s dropped to near 0 for ACME in the last 2 mins. Keep an eye on cost spikes. 

henry: next steps: product to review default rerank quotas and consider raising default or tiering per plan. Also document per-endpoint quotas in public docs and add migration guide for batching patterns. 

eva: thanks all — please add postmortem + action items. Customer outreach assigned to @leila. 

anya: created support ticket SUP-9872 and linked to INC-2026-142. Will follow up with parallel request to product for quota default review. 

leila: ACME notified, they're happy with the temporary lift but want long-term plan. 

michael: adding a code snippet for SDK retry pattern to share with customers:

```js
await retry(async () => {
  const res = await client.rerank(...);
  if (res.status === 429) throw new RetryableError();
  return res;
}, { retries: 5, minDelay: 200, maxDelay: 2000, jitter: true });
```

eva: closing thread once postmortem is filed. :white_check_mark:
